panel.title: Merge?! Fall in Love with Fortune Bang Bang Chicken!

panel.description: Jinwoo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.
panel.title: If I Had One More Chance

panel.description: Satou has married Hime and become the legendary Ring King who will save Arnulus from the threat of the Abyss King. They struggle to advance their relationship, but there's no time to enjoy their newlywed life as the Abyss King's pursuers close in.
panel.title: Episode 2

panel.description: Rud returns to his hometown of Avancia with Luna in tow and reunites with his sister, who quickly takes to the new addition to the household.

episode_metadata.series_title: The Strongest Tank's Labyrinth Raids -A Tank with a Rare 9999 Resistance Skill Got Kicked from the Hero's Party-

panel.title: Return to Avancia

panel.description: Ah-Duo's replacement has arrived in the rear palace, and Maomao is assigned to give a certain lecture to all four high concubines. Later, Maomao helps Lihaku investigate a warehouse explosion.
panel.title: The New Pure Consort

panel.description: Sunraku and the others gather to take a look back at past events to get viewers refreshed and up to date before their battle with Wethermon the Tombguard.
panel.title: Shangri-La Frontier Special Bonus Episode

panel.description: The Bureau of Magic calls upon an emergency inquiry regarding the concealment of Mash's lack of magic, and the Divine Visionaries gather one by one before Mash.

episode_metadata.season_title: The Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc

panel.title: Mash Burnedead and the Home Visit

panel.description: Himari is determined to settle into life at Momochi House, which won't be as easy as it sounds. The residents are still resistant to her, and her very presence seems to be taking a toll on Aoi...

episode_metadata.season_title: The Demon Prince of Momochi House
episode_metadata.series_title: The Demon Prince of Momochi House

panel.title: Mayoiga

panel.description: Two strangers start asking around town for a witch, but the locals don't take kindly to their insinuations. Do they speak from baseless prejudice, or is there more to the city's hero than she lets on?
panel.title: The Witch and the City of Blazing Red

panel.description: In the dungeon, Rentt encounters a rookie adventurer named Rina and attempts to enlist her aid with his predicament.
panel.title: The Rookie and the Veteran

panel.description: Following the discovery of his unique power, Usato has been recruited/abducted into the kingdom's Rescue Team. And he has no idea the hellacious training he's in for!

episode_metadata.season_title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic - Season 01
episode_metadata.series_title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic

panel.title: The Training from Hell Begins!

panel.description: Sasaki gets the hang of his trading operation in the other world right about the time he gets in over his head in the modern world. He's (forcibly) recruited into a government agency for psychics, and his first job is right around the corner.
panel.title: A First Job and a Partner

panel.description: Frieren and party finally arrive in Äußerst, ready to undergo the first-class mage exam, and meet a number of colorful characters who are there to do the same.
panel.title: First-Class Mage Exam

panel.description: Shinsuke plans to attack a local group of brigands, only to be beaten to the bunch by the eccentric Tama and Jinka. Impressed by their prowess in battle, Shinsuke becomes determined to follow them, and offers to take them to the brigands' leader.
panel.title: We Are Those Who Lament This Barbaric Age

panel.description: Yukimura injures his leg while the group is training for the upcoming tests. He later devises a plan for how the group should handle the marathon and then the day of the four tests arrives.
panel.title: Man is wolf to man.

panel.description: Songstress Sarah Fitzgerald takes a mysterious girl named Rouge as her helper. After one of her performances, Sarah and her lover are attacked, and a woman named Naomi approaches Rouge with information about Sarah. What is Sarah hiding in her past?
panel.title: Crimson Is the Sound of Dawn

panel.description: Light Magic and the Hero is a game that follows Alicia Ehnleit and her companions. But we're not following that story. The game's hidden boss no longer has any interest in antagonizing them. She simply wants to grind levels and live peacefully.

episode_metadata.season_title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
episode_metadata.series_title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord

panel.title: The Hidden Boss Enters the Academy

panel.description: Mr. Villain is a high-ranking member of the Evil League, but when he's taking a day off from world conquest, he cares mostly about work-life balance. His days off are filled with shopping, pandas, and chance encounters with familiar faces.
panel.title: We Need Comfort Too

panel.description: The princess of the Royal Empire finds herself imprisoned by the demonic Hellhorde, but she resists with an iron will. That is, until the Grand Inquisitor decides to resort to more unusual forms of torture...
panel.title: Episode 1

panel.description: Shiki Tsubasa has just moved from Tokyo to the city of Kitami in Hokkaido. When he gets lost, a flirty gal named Fuyuki Minami points him in the right direction. After the two meet again at school, Minami invites Tsubasa to hang out with her at home.
panel.title: Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable

panel.description: Makoto and Shiki are making their way to Rotsgard Academy in hopes of opening a new store. Meanwhile, back in the demiplane, everyone is helping Mio practice her cooking skills by taste testing her dishes.
panel.title: What? Moon over the Ruined Castle?

panel.description: Rishe Irmgard Weitzner, daughter of a duke, has a secret—she dies at age twenty and loops back to a moment five years prior. As her seventh loop begins, she swears to live a long, relaxed life. Then, the man who killed her in her sixth life appears!

episode_metadata.series_title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!

panel.title: The Fiancé Who Killed Me

panel.description: Sunraku has encountered a new player named Dragonfly in "BERP". The two engage in a series of matches with bug exploits allowed. Afterwards Sunrakru heads to Rabituza to link his skills at the Skill Garden.
panel.title: Squish

panel.description: Having lost his powers, Shirogane now has a problem he has to deal with, and a proposition for Suzu and Matsuri.
panel.title: Kanade Suzu, the King of Ayakashi

panel.description: After an extraordinary demonstration of her ability to bond with animals, Neema is in for... extraordinary consequences? The king expects an explanation, and everyone is watching closely!
panel.title: I've Been Summoned

panel.description: Yuki, who was born in a world where sounds don't sound like anything, runs into the enigmatic Itsuomi and immediately takes an interest in him.
panel.title: Yuki's World

panel.description: Rud is a tank, the member of an adventuring party that protects the others by soaking up attacks. When he is kicked out of his party for losing his absorb shield too quickly on a labyrinth raid, he considers what his next move should be.

episode_metadata.series_title: The Strongest Tank's Labyrinth Raids -A Tank with a Rare 9999 Resistance Skill Got Kicked from the Hero's Party-

panel.title: Kicked from the Party

panel.description: Around ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jinwoo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.
panel.title: I'm Used to It

panel.description: To Maomao's surprise, Jinshi brings her directly to his house instead of taking her back to the rear palace, and tells her she's to work in the outer court. Not only is there much to learn, it seems there's many eyes on her as the new hire.
panel.title: Serving in the Outer Court

panel.description: Discovering that Maomao's kidnappers were connected to Fengming's family, Jinshi is faced with a choice between keeping Maomao in the rear palace where he can be near her or releasing her from her service.
panel.title: The Eunuch and the Courtesan

panel.description: After Cell War from Innocent Zero leaves, a rumor that Mash can't use magic begins to spread around the school.

episode_metadata.season_title: The Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc

panel.title: Mash Burnedead and the Divine Visionaries

panel.description: Satou, an ordinary male student, was unable to confess his love to his childhood friend, Hime, but one day she suddenly announces she's moving far away. Satou chases after Hime and follows her through a gate of light into another world known as Arnulus!
panel.title: Episode 1

panel.description: The battle with the Jinyo intensifies, and Shirogane has to fend him off with Suzu in tow!
panel.title: The Spirit of Harmony

panel.description: When Alice loses one of her mother’s earrings in the snow, the Duke goes out into the cold, dark night to look for it. Meanwhile, a lost witch finds the Duke lying unconscious in the snow and decides to help him. Does she know how to break his curse?

episode_metadata.season_title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
episode_metadata.series_title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

panel.title: The Duke, Alice, and Memories of Snow

panel.description: After losing a bet to Alice, the Duke agrees to take her to the town’s masquerade festival. But the two get separated when the Duke, clad in a clunky, steel costume to protect others from his touch of death, gets carried away by the crowd…

episode_metadata.season_title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
episode_metadata.series_title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

panel.title: The Duke and the Meteor Shower During the Full Moon

panel.description: The Fuwa Rescue Squad leaves the collapsed road. Feeling the weight of the lives they couldn’t save, Daigo and Shun fall into silence. Watching them, Yamagami reminisces about how far they’ve come.

episode_metadata.season_title: Firefighter Daigo: Rescuer in Orange - Season 01

panel.title: The Sun Will Rise Again

panel.description: On her 16th birthday, Momochi Himari the orphan receives a will from her deceased parents and inherits Momochi House.

episode_metadata.season_title: The Demon Prince of Momochi House
episode_metadata.series_title: The Demon Prince of Momochi House

panel.title: Strangers of Momochi House

panel.description: Ordinary high school student Usato is mistakenly suddenly summoned to another world along with his classmates and student council members Suzune and Kazuki.

episode_metadata.season_title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic - Season 01
episode_metadata.series_title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic

panel.title: Dragged into Another World!

panel.description: Sasaki, a lonely office worker pushing forty, adopts an adorable bird to brighten up his life a bit... Little does he know that the Java sparrow he picks, Peeps, is a powerful mage who's going to bring him a whole lot more than he bargained for.
panel.title: Real Life and Fantasy

panel.description: Now that Sein finally has a lead on the whereabouts of his long-lost friend, is it time for him and Frieren's party to part ways?
panel.title: Take Care

panel.description: While hunting weak monsters in a labyrinth, perennial bronze-class adventurer Rennt discovers an unexplored passageway. He excitedly begins searching it, hoping to earn wealth and renown, but instead he encounters a dragon, the strongest of all monsters.
panel.title: Unwanted Undead

panel.description: At the scene of a collapsed street, Daigo and Shun discover a car with a survivor buried in the sand. However, nothing they do seems to work and they can’t make any progress. That’s when they suggest pulling out the car with the truck’s ladder, but...

episode_metadata.season_title: Firefighter Daigo: Rescuer in Orange - Season 01

panel.title: The Job of Those in Orange

panel.description: The Fuwa Rescue Corps is on the scene at a collapsed street. A car has fallen into the hole, so Daigo and Shun descend using the flexible ladder mounted on their truck. That’s when Daigo senses something...

episode_metadata.season_title: Firefighter Daigo: Rescuer in Orange - Season 01

panel.title: The True Sign of a Buddy

panel.description: Having recovered from a back injury, the Duke's elderly butler Rob resumes his post. But while his work is flawless, some of his five senses aren't quite up to snuff. Meanwhile, a couple of unexpected guests pay a visit to the Duke's mansion…

episode_metadata.season_title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
episode_metadata.series_title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

panel.title: The Duke, His Butler, and a Lost Cat

panel.description: A teenage boy lives deep in the forest, far away from his family and cursed to kill anything he touches. His maid, Alice, is constantly teasing him and getting far too close for comfort…

episode_metadata.series_title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

panel.title: The Duke and Alice

panel.description: Ayanokoji's class embarks on their first trial as the ascended Class C, the mixed training camp.
panel.title: The strongest principle of growth lies in the human choice.

panel.description: When an accident takes the life of Yuta’s childhood friend, he’s left with her cursed spirit. As she harms the people near him, a depressed Yuta must choose between execution or the Jujutsu sorcerers. Can the curse of love turn into his greatest gift?
panel.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN 0

panel.description: Choso begins to realize the identity of the mastermind parasitizing Geto's corpse as sorcerers gather for the final moments of the Shibuya Incident. The special-grade sorcerer, Yuki Tsukumo, comes to the rescue when they're on the verge of death.
panel.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Close

panel.description: Sanji is tormented by the idea of becoming a cruel Germa warrior like his siblings and torn between being strong or being humane as he is now. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.
panel.title: For Luffy – Sanji and Zoro's Oath

panel.description: Law and Kid are having a tough battle against a formidable Emperor of the Sea, Big Mom. However, when they decide to work collaboratively and use their awakened Devil Fruit powers, they see the possibility of taking down the old generation.
panel.title: A Countercharge! Law and Kid's Return-Attack Combination

panel.description: When an exhausted office worker drops dead at her doorstep from overwork, she has but one humble wish for her next life... To be able to pet all of the cuddly creatures she can find! Welcome to a paradise of fluff (that may be home to a few secrets)!
panel.title: Nobody Told Me This Would Happen!

panel.description: A teenage boy lives deep in the forest, far away from his family and cursed to kill anything he touches. His maid, Alice, is constantly teasing him and getting far too close for comfort…

episode_metadata.series_title: The Duke of Death and His Maid

panel.title: The Duke and Alice

panel.description: The Moriarty family is faced with the biggest crisis in its history: They have to host a tea party! Will they successfully complete the mission of entertaining the ladies while protecting the family secrets?
panel.title: Moriarty Family's Day Off

panel.description: The paintings of white lilies painted by a popular noble painter get damaged at Bath, a famous hot spring in England.  Feeling that he's seen the painting before, William goes to Bath, where he is reunited with Sherlock, who happened to be there to investigate the case.
panel.title: Reminiscence of Lilies

panel.description: In order to save his father, Akira has to become a zombie. Faced with the ultimate choice, what will he choose to do? Will Akira and his friends have to give up on their list of 100 things they want to do before becoming zombies?

episode_metadata.season_title: Zom 100: Bucket List of The Dead - Season 01
episode_metadata.series_title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

panel.title: Hometown of the Dead III

panel.description: Sanji still wonders what is happening to his body as he receives attacks. Meanwhile, the dying Kin'emon hears an unexpected voice calling for the also dying Kanjuro. Through the Smail, the voice of Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.
panel.title: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames

panel.description: God candidate and grade school student Susumu reveals information relating to the new God selection process on a live TV broadcast. As a result, people around the world begin searching for God candidates. Mirai and Saki are under a lot of stress. The whole world is looking for them, and their identities must not be discovered no matter what... but one day, on the way home from school, an MPD...
panel.title: World's Greatest Assassin

panel.description: Deimon realizes that they will need a kicker to win their game against the Bando Spiders.
panel.title: Come back, Musashi!

panel.description: The Bando Spiders face off against the Ojo White Knights.
panel.title: The Spider's Sting!

panel.description: After losing to the Seibu Gunmen, Tetsuma rescues Monta from getting Deimon suspended from playing.
panel.title: A Pact Between Rivals!

panel.description: Kid tells Hiruma that he fell directly into his trap, and that everything is always too good to be true.
panel.title: The Fateful Kick!

panel.description: As the Deimon-Seibu game goes on, Sena finds out that he's more than a match for his friend Riku and brings the Devil Bats close to victory with his Devil Bat Tornado.
panel.title: Lightspeed Pride!

panel.description: Finally, with all the Devil Bats on the field, Hiruma can unleash the true power of the Devil Bats, but will it be enough to overtake the Seibu team?
panel.title: A Demonic Counterattack!

panel.description: After seeing the dire straits the Deimon team is in, and a stern talking to from his father, Musashi rejoins the Devil Bats.
panel.title: Musashi is Right Here!

panel.description: With the triple threat of Riku, Tetsuma, and the Kid bearing down on the Devil Bats, it looks like their luck may have run out.
panel.title: The Field of Despair!

panel.description: The game with Seibu has begun and the Devil Bats are getting all they can handle from their running back, Kaitani Riku, the boy that taught Sena how to run.
panel.title: Proof He's the Fastest!

panel.description: As the time approaches for the game against the Seibu Wild Gunmen, Hiruma, Kurita, and Musashi all recall the promise they made to go to the Christmas Bowl.
panel.title: The Three Made a Promise!

panel.description: Ishimaru and the track team need an extra man, so they ask Sena to help out. How will Sena keep his secret now?
panel.title: The Sprinter's Sena?!

panel.description: Hiruma takes advantage of the school's field day to make it a training session for the team.
panel.title: Field Day at Deimon High School!

panel.description: Riku appears and talks about his past and how Sena could run because of him.
panel.title: The Appearance of a Lightspeed Man!?

panel.description: With the game and their tournament hopes in the balance, Sena and the Devil Bats get help from an unlikely source.
panel.title: Attack and Defense for 30 Centimeters!

panel.description: With pressure by the Devil Bats, Mizumachi and Shun conclude that it's time to unleash the true power of the Kyoushin defense.
panel.title: How Terrifying! The Moby Dick Anchor!

panel.description: The game continues with a stalemate with both teams trying to break the trend and score, knowing that this will lean the game highly in their favor.
panel.title: Obsession with Victory!

panel.description: The Devil Bats have made a comeback, the score is 14-12, and Deimon has the ball!
panel.title: The Promise Made on the Field!

panel.description: Sena finds it difficult to run against the Kyoushin team, so it's up to Hiruma to lead his team down the field.
panel.title: The Secret MVP!

panel.description: A young man named Yuuki awakens in an unknown world with no memory of his past. Together with his self-proclaimed guide, Kokkoro, the pair set forth into the beautiful land of Astraea. After arriving in the royal capital of Landosol, they visit the Guild Association in search of work to pay for their lodging and embark on a mushroom-hunting quest.
panel.title: The Adventure Begins ~Sautéed Mushrooms at Sunset~

panel.description: The five Disciples of Avan have gathered. Mystvearn attempts to intervene, but Lon Beruk stops him. Crocodine and the others fight the army of monsters. The Disciples of Avan prepare the ritual to cast Kaglimmer. But Popp remains uncertain...

episode_metadata.season_title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
episode_metadata.series_title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai (2020)

panel.title: THE FIVE COLORS OF LIGHT

panel.description: Marin and Wakana start to grow closer as he helps her create her cosplay. Though he's happy about the fact that Marin treats him the same way at school as anywhere else, he also starts to worry about the fact that other people think it's weird that they're hanging out. Despite that, Marin takes Wakana shopping so they can look for materials needed for her cosplay.
panel.title: Then Why Don't We?

panel.description: Sena and the Devil Bats start their game against Mizumachi and the Kyoushin Poseidons.
panel.title: The Devils vs. The Sea Gods!

panel.description: When Monta and Sena are sent to spy on the Poseidons' final practice before the game, they are caught, and Kakei tells Sena that he wants to challenge Eyeshield 21!
panel.title: The Man Who Remembers #21!

panel.description: Komusubi starts learning sumo. With his special training, he finds a way to overcome the physical difference between himself and Mizumachi and Kakei.
panel.title: Toss him out! The Honorable Komusubi!

panel.description: With the game with the Scorpions behind them, Deimon prepares to play the Kyoushin Poseidons. However they may be with out one of their linemen, Komusubi's run away.
panel.title: A Physique-al Barrier!

panel.description: After seeing how passionate Marin is about the things she loves, Wakana decides to help her with making outfits. He decides to help her out in making a cosplay for Shizuku Kuroe-tan from the game "Slippery Girls 2." They had planned to reconvene later to get the measurements started, but Marin couldn't wait and ends up coming to Wakana's house over the weekend.
panel.title: Wanna Hurry Up, and Do It?

panel.description: Wakana Gojo is a high school student who dreams of becoming a kashirashi for hina dolls one day. Because his life is all about making hina dolls, he has a hard time fitting into his class because his interests are so different than anyone else’s. His classmate, Marin Kitagawa, is always at the center of attention and from another world. One day, they both end up on classroom cleaning duty and…
panel.title: Someone Who Lives in the Exact Opposite World as Me

panel.description: In exchange for Mukaido's life, his actions finally end their long battle with Metropoliman AKA Kanade. However, Mirai notices that Kanade has secretly been shot with a Red Arrow by someone else...Who was controlling Kanade? The MPD begins investigating the identities of the God candidates, and the situation enters the next phase. And then, a new God candidate begins to act.
panel.title: Diffused Power

panel.description: With Hiruma MIA and the Scorpions in the lead, it looks like the Deimon team's Christmas Bowl dreams are doomed... until Mamori remembers the game plan Hiruma entrusted to her.
panel.title: The Missing Leader!

panel.description: Sena and the Devil Bats play their game with the Dokubari Scorpions, who consider football to be just as much of a mind game as a physical one. However their captain Kanagushia failed to take into account Hiruma's superior tactics....
panel.title: The Fearsome, Venomous Scorpions!

panel.description: Chamelon and Poseidon start their game. Poseidon has a great advantage because they have tall players and the Chameleon team is not united.
panel.title: Clash! The Chameleons vs. the Poseidons!

panel.description: Eyeshield 21 enters the Chameleons' locker room and cuts up all their uniforms in the middle of the night. Sena said he did not do it. The Chameleons enter Deimon and try to find Eyeshield 21.
panel.title: Beware! The Demonic Chameleons!

panel.description: A typhoon approaches as Kukuru locks herself inside Gama Gama to protest its closure.
panel.title: At the End of the Siege

panel.description: Destiny is terribly cruel. But no matter how much misfortune the gods torment me with, I will face my destiny. Because of that, I fought, and I fought, and I fought some more... And then, I finally found my answer. There truly was joy beyond the pain. Now, it is time for the performance to begin. I shall now wring destiny's neck. <From a certain man's memoirs>
panel.title: Takt -Hope-

panel.description: A giant Black Night Siderite starts to stir as Sagan hums a certain melody. The Black Night Siderite that grows as big as a tree starts to swallow up the New York Symphonica. Sagan has finally made his move to make his ambitions come true. As Takt and Destiny witness this eerie spectacle, they find out that Anna and Charlotte are still inside the Symphonica.
panel.title: Preparing for Battle -Orpheus-

panel.description: Lenny remembers his own past. Lenny recalls someone very dear to him. Everything leading up to today was so that he could do everything he could to do what he had to do. Lenny heads to the meeting point along with Titan so they can tell Takt and Destiny everything. But someone rather unexpected was waiting for them.
panel.title: Master and Pupil -Lenny-

panel.description: Sena learns the truth about the "real" Eyeshield 21 from a Poseidon player, Kakei Shun. Discouraged after hearing that he may never catch up to the real Eyeshield, Sena learns from Shin that it isn't size that matters, but an unwavering spirit.
panel.title: The Courage to Stand Firm!

panel.description: The Devil Bats meet the captain of the Hashiratani Deers, Yamamoto Onihei. The Devil Bats go watch the Deers game against the Kyoshin Poseidon in order to see the team that might become their future opponents.
panel.title: The Refined Spirit of a Lineman!

panel.description: Takt and crew finally reach their destination of New York. They reunite with Charlotte, Anna's older sister, who works for the Symphonica's technological development department. Charlotte begins to examine Destiny. Who is an incomplete Musicart. But then, Anna realizes something is wrong with Takt. The mark on Takt's right arm starts to spread to the rest of his body, and...
panel.title: Family -Eroica-

panel.description: Deimon's game against the Guts begins. Hiruma tries to put pressure on them with words about this being their last chance to go to the Christmas Bowl. However, the Guts' coach has replaced the regular players with athletes from other clubs in order to win.
panel.title: A Battle of Effort, Fortitude, and Will!

panel.description: The Devil Bats witness the physical endurance and team bond of the Yuuhi Guts, their next opponents in the tournament. Hiruma says that the Devil Bats have a 99% chance of winning, but the Yuuhi Guts have a 1% chance of defeating them due to having more experience.
panel.title: Hot! Guts!! Fire! Oh, oops!

panel.description: D2s awakening. Takt's hometown being attacked, and Cosette's death. This was all a part of Sagan's plan. Shindler wants to get rid of all those inferior to him in this desolate world. After learning the truth about Cosette's death, Takt charges at Shindler in a blind rage. But Takt is injured by Hell. As she witnesses Takt injured and bleeding, Destiny feels some emotions welling up inside of her that she's never felt before...
panel.title: Destiny -Cosette-

panel.description: Anna and Destiny happen to see a town destroyed during their travels. D2s are awakening everywhere and attacking various towns and people, reverting the world back to four years ago, before Sagan's Declaration. As the threat from the D2s grew, Takt was obsessing over something. With a blank staff notation in front of him, Takt plays an imaginary keyboard as he desperately tries to create something.
panel.title: Truth -Noise-

panel.description: Now substituting in a corporate league game, Sena and Shin finally get the rematch they've been wanting for so long. However, Shin is disappointed as Sena refuses to use the Devil Bat Ghost due to his previous orders from Hiruma. The Samurais are losing, as the line cannot withstand Ootawara.
panel.title: The Ghost vs. The Spear!

panel.description: Hiruma forbids Sena to use the Devil Bat Ghost until a real game in order to keep it a secret weapon. Meanwhile Shin and Ootawara from Oujou have begun practicing in a corporation league, the Shuuei Elephants, to better hone their skills.
panel.title: The Ghost is Off Limits?!

panel.description: Takt and crew stop by a certain town. All of the young people had fled the town, leaving only the elderly. The residents happen to ask Anna and Destiny for help. Meanwhile, Takt wandered around town on his own and happens to hear a melody quietly resonating from an old bar. It was definitely the sound of music.
panel.title: Sunrise -Rooster-

panel.description: Taki must pass the entrance exam to be able to play for Deimon. Suzuna tells them Taki has failed to be accepted to every single school with American football in Japan except Deimon. But Taki fails again, and Suzana leaves in frustration. As it turns out, Taki can answer the question --only if it is somehow related to American Football.
panel.title: Ah ha ha! My Debut!

panel.description: Monta and Sena are reluctant to recruit the legendary kicker "60 yard Magnum" Musashi back onto the team.
panel.title: The Legendary 60-Yard Magnum!

panel.description: The execution day has arrived. As noon approaches and Vearn Palace arrives in the sky above, Mystvearn appears before Hyunckel and Crocodine. Mystvearn makes Hyunckel an offer: accept his Dark Aura or die. Hyunckel makes an unexpected choice.

episode_metadata.season_title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
episode_metadata.series_title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai (2020)

panel.title: THE DARK HYUNCKEL

panel.description: Mirai and Kanade are unaware that their duel is being streamed online by someone. As people all across Japan and even the MPD watch the stream and leap into action, their duel approaches its end. A Red Arrow seeking happiness against a White Arrow that will grant his desire. What fate awaits those who battle for their lives?
panel.title: Two Lights

panel.description: Chameleon Habashira Rui gives Sena a lift to the stadium on his motorcycle. In the game, Amino decides to target Monta and tackle him on offense and defense. Amino scores another touchdown and Ishimaru and Monta both score touchdowns for Deimon.
panel.title: The Devil Bat Ghost!

panel.description: Deimon are up against Amino, a school where they use medical science to increase their muscles. Sena follows Taki onto the wrong bus and ends in Nagano. Meanwhile Deimon, without their ace, must defeat Amino.
panel.title: The Ace's Missing?!

panel.description: Kurita and the other Devil Bats learn that one loss means their entire dream will end. Once he gets home, Kurita goes into hiding, not wanting to be the cause of the Devil Bats' failure. Can the others convince him to come out?
panel.title: The Night Before the Game!

panel.description: While hiding from a group of television interviewers, Suzuna questions why Sena doesn't tell Mamori who he is. This leads to a quick review of the previous 38 episodes. Sena tells Suzuna that he will tell Mamori his identity when he defeats his ultimate rival, Shin Seijuuro.
panel.title: The Road to the Christmas Bowl!

panel.description: The Goddess has been summoning and reincarnating a broad range of people in order to stop the Hero from destroying the world, but they all seem to have ended in failure. However, all the reincarnations that had been conducted until now were for the purpose of gathering data. With the data she has gathered, she summons the person most likely to stop the Hero.

episode_metadata.series_title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat

panel.title: Battle of Assassin

panel.description: Lon Beruk brings the restored Sword of Dai and new weapons. The group renews their resolve. Maam is shaken by Amy's feelings for Hyunckel and Popp is frustrated his Insignia of Avan won't shine. As the final battle approaches, things grow shaky...

episode_metadata.series_title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai (2020)

panel.title: The Night Before the Battle

panel.description: The Deimon Devil Bats have returned home. Hiruma must decide on the regular players. Everyone but Yukimitsu is chosen. Yukimitsu will continue to be a bench player.
panel.title: The New Starting Lineup?!

panel.description: Lugh is hired to assassinate Dia by her father Count Viekone, who is an old friend of Lugh's father Cian. Cian asks Lugh to fulfill Count Viekone's request, saying he'll carry out the assassination instead if Lugh turns down the job.

episode_metadata.series_title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat

panel.title: Choice of Betrayal

panel.description: The Devil Bats return to Japan, but Hiruma informs them that Oujo lost to Shinryuuji. Speaking of Oujo, Sakuraba reaches a breaking point and seriously considers his future as a football player.
panel.title: The Distant Peak

panel.description: The Devil Bats truck gets stuck in a pothole; with one final push together as a team, Deimon overcomes the last obstacle. Arriving in Las Vegas, on the pirate boat outside Treasure Island, Doburoku confronts Sena to see if the ghost move is mastered.
panel.title: The Final Trial!

panel.description: Yukimitsu collapses during the run. If he does not complete the run, he will be dropped from the team.
panel.title: A Solitary Death March!

panel.description: Sena applies all the training from the death march in the match. When he scores the winning goal, Sena's last opponent declares that he saw a ghost beside Sena as he ran. Suzuna's brother didn't make the team, and so Sena asks him to become a member of the Deimon Devil Bats.
panel.title: Signs of a Ghost!

panel.description: Sena accidentally kicks the rock into a motorcycle gang. Knowing that he will have to run the whole Death March again if he loses it, he runs after them and gets separated from the rest of the team.
panel.title: OH! My Sister!

panel.description: Mirai and Metropoliman agree to fight fair and square by taking turns firing Arrows at each other. As their duel unfolds, Metropoliman reflects on the past and his own personal values.
panel.title: World Peace

panel.description: Fuyuko, one of Kanade's underlings, is a researcher who develops killer viruses. Fuyuko threatens Mirai and his companions by telling them that she'll conduct an indiscriminate terrorist act and spread her killer virus. She demands that they allow her to test her newest drug on them if they want to prevent the attack. Kanade names Mirai as the first guinea pig. Mukaido and Saki desperately try...
panel.title: A Fine Line Between Offense and Defense

panel.description: Saki shoots Hajime with a Red Arrow, and things seem to be looking up for Mirai and Mukaido. However, the situation takes a turn for the worse when Metropoliman summons more bloodthirsty and unhinged allies to join the fight.
panel.title: Your Own Worth

panel.description: Will and his comrades narrowly escape the beasts' trap. Seeing how badly Menel is injured, Will realizes that his capabilities surpass those of his comrades, causing him to put them in danger without even knowing it. Clouded by self-reproach, Will goes to fight the beasts alone, but Menel angrily stands in his way.
panel.title: The Faraway Paladin

panel.description: The training and the heat intensify as the team treks across Texas, but when the situation continues to get rougher, it could lead to one or two people trying to quit altogether. Is this the end of the Devil Bats' training?
panel.title: Quitters?

panel.description: The death march training begins. Monta and Yukimitsu must run routes while Hiruma shoots them. The defensive linemen must push a truck. Sena has to kick a rock across the whole 2000 km. Shin is hiking on Mt. Fuji every day. Panther challenges Shin.
panel.title: Minds Made Up!

panel.description: The Devil Bats are resting at the Wild Gunmen ranch. The coach has agreed to train them. Hiruma mentions that Deimon does not allow extracurricular activities after the third year, so it's his and Kurita's last chance for the Christmas Bowl.
panel.title: At the Gates of Hell!

panel.description: Hiruma orders the members of Devil Bats to the beach. They come across the Seibu Wild Gunmen's coach and Kid. They form a five-man team that will compete in a beach football game for the prize of Texas beef and $1000.
panel.title: Ultimate Combo! The Devil Gunmen!

panel.description: Now that the kingdom of science has access to tungsten, they can finish building the cell phone.
panel.title: Wave of Science

panel.description: Senku, Magma and Chrome explores a cave for tungsten, which they'll need to make durable filaments for their cell phone vacuum tubes. But Magma has other plans in mind.
panel.title: The Treasure

panel.description: Making cell phones takes a lot of materials and tools. Senku begins by upgrading their equipment using the waterwheel Chrome and Kaseki invented and built together.
panel.title: Spartan Crafts Club

panel.description: Tsukasa plans a second attack after a few months of preparation. He has no idea what Senku and his kingdom are cooking up in the meantime.
panel.title: The Age of Energy

panel.description: Tsukasa's army attacks the village. Outmatched by the attackers, they have to rely on wits, cooperation and science to fend them off.
panel.title: To Modernity

panel.description: Tsukasa's army attacks the village, potentially leaving them with no choice but to cut down the bridge and lose Kinro.
panel.title: Stone Wars

panel.description: Through Byakuya's message to Senku, we learn of the events that started Ishigami Village.
panel.title: A Hundred Nights and a Thousand Skies

panel.description: Having been anointed as a Paladin, Will turns his focus to rebuilding the village and exterminating monsters. One day, one of Will's patrol parties goes missing. When Will, Menel, and "the Penetrator" Reystov return to Beast Woods to search for it, they discover the scattered remains of his comrades. Sensing something is wrong, they proceed deeper into the valley.
panel.title: Valley of Despair

panel.description: Will is summoned to meet with Ethelbald, the lord of Whitesails, who refers to him as the "Wyvern Slayer." He offers to gather private soldiers so he can stop the damage caused by all the beast attacks in the area. Will's sudden proposal earns a cold reaction at first, but after a closer look at Will, Ethelbald grants him permission. So Will enters the Whitesails tavern in search of reliable...
panel.title: Renowned Glory

panel.description: Bii and Tonio have joined Will on his journey, and the party finally arrives in Whitesails. Will has never seen such a big, lively city, and he is deeply impressed. He hopes to relieve the exhaustion of his journey, but suddenly, an alarm sounds. He hurries outside and sees a massive shadow flying directly over his head.
panel.title: Whitesails

panel.description: Having saved the village from the Demon's attack, Will and Menel decide to head toward the city of Whitesails, a booming trade center. As they pass through Beast Woods, they suddenly hear a scream. Running in its direction, Will and Menel see two travelers being attacked by a Giant Ape.
panel.title: Songs of Heroism

panel.description: A look back at Will's experiences and travels thus far.
panel.title: The Path Taken

panel.description: Menel leads Will to a village that's being attacked by monsters. As he banishes them, he learns gravity of the tragedies caused by the attack. Piled-up bodies and burnt houses are everywhere. Then, from their midst, a faint voice catches Menel's attention. The voice belongs to a severely burnt young boy who has turned undead.
panel.title: Traumatic Memory

panel.description: Will departs from the city of the dead and sets foot in the outside world. After walking in the woods for several days, the first being he meets is Menel, a half-elf hunter. Will is delighted to talk to someone his own age and continues to recall it even after they go their separate ways. That night, he receives a revelation from Gracefeel.
panel.title: Archer of Beast Woods

panel.description: Dai trains with Nova and masters both types of Avan Strash, leading him to create a new attack. Leona and the others search the Cave of Trials to attain Kaglimmer. Popp grows desperate that his Isignia of Avan is the only one which will not glow...?

episode_metadata.series_title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai (2020)

panel.title: THE SACRED INHERITANCE

panel.description: Young Dai lives on Dermline Island, where he dreams of being a Hero. One day, a Hero and his companions come to the island. Dai is excited at first, but their true intent is to steal his best friend, Gomechan, the mythical Golden Metal Slime.

episode_metadata.season_title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
episode_metadata.series_title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai (2020)

panel.title: DAI, THE TINY HERO

panel.description: Having won the Grand Bout fair and square, and having cured village priestess Ruri of her pneumonia, Senku has won the hearts and minds of the village. Ruri delivers Senku a message from someone dear.
panel.title: A Tale for the Ages

panel.description: With Magma defeated, it's down to Senku and Ginro to take the throne. Although both are on the same team, one is driven by personal greed and opportunism. The fight is on!
panel.title: The Culmination of Two Million Years

panel.description: The Grand Bout is on. The kingdom of science must defeat Magma and take the seat of the village chief in order to give Ruri the antibiotic and win over the village.
panel.title: Master of Flame

panel.description: All that's needed to make antibiotics is alcohol. The best way to get some is to win the Grand Bout, which the Senku and his kingdom will also need to do in order to keep Magma away from Ruri and give her the drug.
panel.title: Masked Warrior

panel.description: To make antibiotics, Senku and his kingdom need to obtain sulfuric acid from a fountain of the stuff. The team goes prepared, but there's no guarantee that they'll make it back alive.
panel.title: Buddies Back to Back

panel.description: The development of glassworks, an important step for making sulfa drugs and for chemistry as a whole, turns out to have a surprising benefit for Suika.
panel.title: Clear World

panel.description: Senku and his kingdom of science successfully test the first lightbulb since the collapse. Meanwhile, Asagiri Gen, a spy from Tsukasa's empire, is killed by an unknown attacker.
panel.title: A Flimsy Alliance

panel.description: Senku starts a ramen stand in hopes of winning over support for his kingdom of science, but some people are too principled to take such a bribe. Mentalist Asagiri Gen is not one of them.
panel.title: Let There Be the Light of Science

panel.description: Kohaku's sister, village priestess Ruri, is gravely ill. Senku, Chrome and Kohaku begin their quest to make antibiotics to save her life.
panel.title: Stone Road

panel.description: Kohaku shows Senku to her village, but it's going to take some convincing before they let him in. In the meantime, he makes friends with a like-minded, promising "sorcerer."
panel.title: Where Two Million Years Have Gone

panel.description: Taiju and Yuzuriha figure out Senku's secret to reviving him. But now that he's back, they need to deal with Tsukasa.
panel.title: Two Nations of the Stone World

panel.description: Tsukasa demands that Senku abandons science, but there's no way he can do that. Tsukasa is left with no choice but to kill him.
panel.title: Stone World The Beginning

panel.description: With the island test over, Ayanokoji Kiyotaka and the others are enjoying their summer vacation on a luxury liner. Suddenly, they're interrupted by a new special test. Ayanokoji is called into the same room as Karuizawa Kei and others, where they learn that this test isn't strictly along class lines...
panel.title: Remember to keep a clear head in difficult times.

panel.description: Ruby Rose, a girl who admires Huntsmen, along with her elder sister Yang Xiao Long enroll into Beacon Academy, a training school for Huntsmen. Her talents were discovered by Ozpin, the school’s Headmaster.
panel.title: Red, White, Black, Yellow

panel.description: The magician of the forest invites Chise into his library. Chise is reluctant at first, but they develop a strong friendship that would have a lasting influence on her.

episode_metadata.season_title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: Those Awaiting a Star

panel.title: Part 2

panel.description: Shikimori-san is at the mall to buy an outfit for the first date she and Izumi-kun have had in a long time. For some reason, her older brother, who still treats her like a child, is at the mall with her.
panel.title: Not Just a Cutie

panel.description: Chise is the student and future bride of the Thorn Sorcerer, Elias. They receive a package from Angelica in London: mostly textbooks, save for one special book.

episode_metadata.season_title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: Those Awaiting a Star

panel.title: Part 1

panel.description: Shu is always in trouble with money but manages to live thanks to the support given by his ex-girlfriend Ayano and the ever-devoted Kisara. The same goes for his job as a PMC. With Ayano's cooperation, Shu won a bidding war at a discounted price to participate in the "D Hazard" prevention operation that occurred in a casino. At the scene of the demon extermination, he planned to rely on...
panel.title: A Loser and a Demon and a Man and a Woman

panel.description: Takina Inoue, a secret agent who protects the security of Japan called a “Lycoris,” is ordered to transfer to the café LycoReco in consequence of a certain incident. Takina is enthusiastic about returning to DA now that she’s buddied up with the super-elite No. 1 Lycoris (?) Chisato, but her job at LycoReco is just one weird thing after another!?
panel.title: Easy does it

panel.description: During the celebration dinner for the victorious match against Seikyo High, a soccer game comes on the TV at the BBQ restaurant, showing Kuribayashi making his J1 debut.
panel.title: Turn

panel.description: As Mizuhara looks set to quit the rental girlfriend business, Kazuya goes to watch a play, one that could be pivotal to their relationship.
panel.title: Dream and Girlfriend

panel.description: Chizuru and Mami go on an awkward rental date unaware that Kazuya has seen them together. How can Chizuru handle this situation?
panel.title: Confession and Girlfriend

panel.description: On Chizuru's request, Kazuya goes on a practice date with Sumi, another rental girlfriend. Will he actually be able to help her and stay out of trouble while he's at it?
panel.title: Truth and Girlfriend
